_comment: Extends the embedded classification defaults in src/mcpfanout/classify.py. remote_leaf_suffixes are hosted APIs that cannot be run on our own machine (a leaf where the chain breaks). self_hostable_suffixes are destinations known to be self-hostable MCP nodes or local services (recursable interior). Both extend, never shrink, the built-in defaults. Curate this down as unknown domains are identified; an unknown public domain counts as a leaf until listed.
